findings.evidence: PR lines 37-58 use `[Algebra k K]` and `algebraMap k K`; Mathlib has `AlgCat.restrictScalars {R S} ... (f : R →+* S) : AlgCat S ⥤ AlgCat R` at `Mathlib/Algebra/Category/AlgCat/Basic.lean:261`.
findings.fix: Give the object/map/functor an explicit parameter `(f : k →+* K)` and build the temporary algebra structures with `Algebra.compHom _ f`, matching `AlgCat.restrictScalars`; the base-change file can call it with `algebraMap k K`.
findings.issue: `restrictScalarsObj`, `restrictScalarsMap`, and `restrictScalars` are specialized to the default `[Algebra k K]`, so they cannot restrict along a non-default ring hom `k →+* K`; this is stronger than the nearby Mathlib API for the same construction.

summary: The finite-type Hopf base-change wrapper is at the intended level, but the new commutative restriction-of-scalars API is less general than the Mathlib convention it mirrors.
